    function setGoogleOneTapZindex() {
        const spMessageContainer = document.querySelector('div[id^="sp_message_container_"]');
        const googleOneTap = document.querySelector('[id^="credential_picker_"]');

        console.log("GSZ: spMessageContainer", spMessageContainer)

    /**
     * Sync Sourcepoint consent status to backend
     * @param {string|undefined} consentUUID - Consent UUID from Sourcepoint (undefined for non-GDPR)
     * @param {object} info - Consent info object from Sourcepoint
     */
    function sendConsentToBackend(consentUUID, info) {
        const payload = {
            consentUUID: consentUUID ?? null,
            consentedToAll: info.consentedToAll ?? null,
            applies: info.applies ?? null,
            categories: info.categories ?? {}
        };

        console.log('Syncing consent payload:', payload);

        // Wait for DOM to be ready to ensure page request has completed
        const sendConsent = () => {
            fetch('/consent', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-TOKEN': 'SRs8yhWzWv8X6NjpMdYQdBMUmKuaVhI2iWsYKbEg',
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
                .then(response => {
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
                    }
                    return response.json();
                })
                .then(data => console.log('Consent synced:', data))
                .catch(err => console.error('Consent sync failed:', err));
        };

        // If DOM already loaded, send immediately. Otherwise wait.
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', sendConsent);
        } else {
            sendConsent();
        }
    }

    (function () {
        try {
            const state = window.globalState;
            if (!state?.user?.is_logged_in) return;

            const localTheme = window.localStorage?.getItem("theme");
            const cookieTheme = document.cookie
                .split("; ")
                .find((row) => row.startsWith("theme="))
                ?.split("=")[1];
            const rawPreference = localTheme || cookieTheme || "light";
            const preference = ["light", "dark", "system"].includes(
                rawPreference
            )
                ? rawPreference
                : "light";
            const prefersDark =
                window.matchMedia &&
                window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
            const active =
                preference === "dark" ||
                (preference === "system" && prefersDark)
                    ? "dark"
                    : "light";

            const root = document.documentElement;
            root.setAttribute("data-theme", preference);
            root.classList.remove("light", "dark", "system");
            root.classList.add(active);
        } catch (error) {
            // Fail closed: leave the default theme to avoid breaking page load.
        }
    })();
</script>

        (() => {
            const flag = "mn_pagecache_probe";
            const enabled = (() => {
                try {
                    return localStorage.getItem(flag) === "on";
                } catch (_) {
                    return false;
                }
            })();

            if (!enabled || window.__MN_PAGECACHE_PROBE_INSTALLED__) return;
            window.__MN_PAGECACHE_PROBE_INSTALLED__ = true;

            const marker = "__MN_PAGECACHE_PROBE__";
            const version = "1.0.2";

            const navEntry = () => performance.getEntriesByType?.("navigation")?.[0];

            const payload = (eventName, event) => ({
                marker,
                version,
                capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                event: eventName,
                persisted:
                    typeof event?.persisted === "boolean" ? event.persisted : null,
                url: location.href,
                visibilityState: document.visibilityState,
                hasFocus: document.hasFocus(),
                navigationType: navEntry()?.type || null,
                historyLength: history.length,
                performanceNow: Math.round(performance.now()),
                resources: performance.getEntriesByType?.("resource")?.length ?? null,
                dom: {
                    elements: document.getElementsByTagName("*").length,
                    iframes: document.querySelectorAll("iframe").length,
                    scripts: document.scripts.length,
                    images: document.images.length,
                },
            });

            const record = (eventName, event) => {
                console.log(marker, JSON.stringify(payload(eventName, event)));
            };

            addEventListener("pageshow", (event) => record("pageshow", event), true);
            addEventListener("pagehide", (event) => record("pagehide", event), true);
            addEventListener(
                "visibilitychange",
                (event) => {
                    record("visibilitychange", event);
                },
                true
            );

            record("probe-installed");
        })();

                                    class="post-body mt-2.5 leading-6 prose prose-bullets-dark w-full break-words dark:text-white max-lg:scroll-mt-28"
                                >
                                <p>I wouldn’t buy anything just yet.  She’s too young to know where she wants to be in the medium term.  You don’t want the flat to become a millstone.</p>
<p>Let her live at home for a couple of years, or rent in a shared building with your home as a bolthole.  Then she’ll have more of an idea of her career path, where her friends are, etc -  and hopefully greater earnings too.  I also suspect prices especially for flats are going to drop or at worst stay flat over the next couple of years, so no harm in waiting.</p>

                                >
                                <p>My first 1 bedroom flat I bought for 250 in Walthamstow 13 years ago</p>
<p>sold in 2021 for 325 and it sold FAST</p>
<p>moved to a 2 bed flat  2022 in Tottenham for 370</p>
<p>just had offer accepted for 435£</p>
<p>I don’t really believe this whole impossible to sell thing all my friends have started in 1 bed flats then they move on and they always sell fast</p>
<p>my building I live in now the 1 beds are always being sold and new people moving in every few years</p>
<p>also I don’t think it really matters too much about area it’s so easy to get around anyway - I’m always all over London for various things meeting different people - always night buses and weekends theirs the tube all night</p>

                                </div>

                                >
                                <p>If she’s 22 and on 30k sounds like she’s just graduated and in her first proper job. If this is the case pls don’t buy!! The best thing about being in London in your 20s is the living with new friends, moving around and finding where you want to be long term. In a few years she’ll likely be able to get a much bigger mortgage, probably have a partner to buy with and know what she wants. Being candid, any flat in London for under 350k is going to be very scruffy / in a questionable area. Anything you see on rightmove will either be shared ownership or have some reason (eg unmortgageable) its so low. Spareroom and ‘clapham rooms for rent’ on Facebook etc are great places to find shared flats with other people in the same position. Much more fun, cheaper in the long run (shared bills etc) and safer. Most young professionals in London buy nearer 30 for exactly that reason.</p>
